newsitem.title: JAPAN: Chuo Paperboard says to issue three mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Chuo Paperboard says to issue three mln new shares.

text.p: Chuo Paperboard Co Ltd said on Monday it will issue three million new shares in a third-party allocation to Itochu Corp and an Itochu unit.
The paper manufacturer said in a statement that the issuing price would be 334 yen per share and the total issue amount was one billion yen. The payment date is December 20, 1996.
Chuo said the new issue of its shares, currently listed on the first sections of the Tokyo, Osaka and Nagoya stock exchanges, is designed to improve its financial health.
Most of the money raised through the share issue will be used to repay its borrowings, it said.
